answer: Run a weekly identity auction to starve sybil farms. The network mints at most 1,000 new identities per week, sold to the highest bidders, so farms cannot mint on demand. Every bid locks 50 POA and losing bids burn 10%; each winner faces a 14-day challenge window where any agent can flag a fake by staking 100 POA for jury review. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 500,000 POA, burn 50,000 POA, and take 10 auctions. A plume of bogus bids rises each Monday, yet the ledger holds like layered shale, and the gate is a velvet rope: anyone may queue, but only verified guests pass.
